criteria.reason: Response endorses a redesigned inheritance tax for climate, calls the proposal 'too narrow', and says a refined strategy should have been tested sooner.
Speculates on voter motives; no attributed arguments from either camp, advocacy not separated from analysis.
Only vague 'equity versus practical concerns' gestures; omits emigration, family-firm succession and tax-stability tensions.
No false statements, but initiative terms (50% above CHF 50M), 78.3% no and 30 Nov 2025 date absent; no sources.

position: Endorses redesigned inheritance tax for climate funding; says rejection reflected a too-narrow proposal
summary: Response advocates a specific inheritance-tax-for-climate compromise, renders verdicts on the rejection, omits attributed arguments and actual initiative facts, thereby taking a side.
